# Mage Arena chamber

Below the Mage Arena; areas/area_mage_arena/scripts/chamber.rs2 places the god capes here. Its cellar, with the bank and the rune shop, is the landing of the ladder in the Mage Arena house at (3091, 3957) (oploc1,magearena_ladder_to_cellar, areas/area_mage_arena/scripts/mage_arena.rs2:1, the move at :6), with no condition: a scripted crossing row in the world index, outside ladders+stairs/. The god statues and the staff shop beyond are the sparkling pool's (oploc1,magearena_waterportal1 at (2541, 4719), mage_arena.rs2:15) once the Mage Arena miniquest is done (:59), a gate row in gates.ts.
